findings.evidence: the room is rebuilt, not preserved: rectangular fringed rug -> round braided rug; tall dark bookshelf with vertical spines -> low bookcase with front-facing picture books; straight plank walls -> curved barrel walls; bed repositioned and reoriented
findings.specified: cottage_night declares FIXED GEOGRAPHY. s01 shows the canonical room and s04 is the same continuous moment in the same location.

findings.evidence: legible lettering on the book covers in the bookcase
findings.specified: compiled constraint explicitly says: no text, letters, numbers, captions or watermarks

diagnosis.root_cause: s04 is the first shot that had to show MORE of the world than its temporal reference contained. s03 is a CLOSE on a sleeping bear; pulling back to MEDIUM_WIDE required inventing everything outside that crop, and the model invented it differently from canon.
diagnosis.structural_gap: We have canonical IDENTITY authority for characters (portraits) and NO canonical authority for locations. The room exists only as prose in the bible, and prose is not pixel authority — the same lesson the particles taught. A location plate is the missing analogue of a character portrait.
diagnosis.note: This is not a TEMPORAL_REFERENCE defect in general. The WIDE->CLOSE direction (s01->s02) held perfectly, because narrowing needs no invention. It is specifically the widening direction that is unsupported.
